gallery.title: File:Pepsi monorail at the Pleasure Beach - geograph.org.uk - 1579245.jpg
gallery.description:
Pepsi monorail at the Pleasure Beach The pillars of the old Cableway also feature in the picture - that was closed in 2000 and taken down due to the dangers of exposure to high wind speeds.
Only when I uploaded the picture did I notice that the monorail is running with one of its doors open!
